comment: Owner-provided Ed25519 public keys trusted to sign Qronos local update manifests (core/local_update.py). The one entry is the public trustedKeyEntry printed by create-key when the real owner key was created on 2026-10-09 from the reviewed b76a904 signer (provenance: docs/local-update-packages.md). Listing a key does not make any install possible: the update launch stays refused until its wiring is reviewed. Adding or revoking a key is an owner decision made in a reviewed change. Never put a private key here or anywhere in the repository.
